text:
ᓚᘏᗢ  Midjourney art ⇢ Chatgpt image 2 storyboard ⇢  Seedance 2 video 
( I did some manual edit, Seedance didn't get it perfect) but Kling omni did prompt well but not same style https://t.co/1e5AS2RhUX
content: Create a Seedance 2 video by first generating Midjourney art, then converting it into a storyboard with ChatGPT Image 2, and using that storyboard as the input for Seedance 2.

extra_content.quoted_text: love this painting effect in this midjourney style --sref 281860989 3890701259 --niji 7 https://t.co/dLfqMgOOhX

translations.es:
Crea un video de Seedance 2 generando primero arte con Midjourney, luego conviértelo en un storyboard con ChatGPT Image 2, y utiliza ese storyboard como entrada para Seedance 2.
